# Pregame injury snapshots (forward-looking only)

These ESPN freezes have an explicit `captureTimestamp`. They are **not** a 2023–2024 historical archive.

**Forbidden:** joining a 2026 (or any current) snapshot into Phase E 2024 holdout `injuryKnown` / `qbOut` labels.

E4 still requires many snapshots with `captureTimestamp < kickoffIso` for the holdout games under test.
